data.name: Luna
data.description:
——Details——

Luna is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. She is a child with necromantic powers living in a dark, distant mansion. Though villagers fear to approach, she is ready to venture out into the world.

Luna is the default leader for the Shadowcraft class.

——Personality——

Being young in age, Luna is very childish, always asking those she meets to be her friend and to play games with her. At first, she doesn't seem to understand what death is or that her parents are deceased, and communicates with them freely. But after finally figuring it out, she can no longer talk to them, and becomes terrified of death, or finding out that her friends could die.

As a child, Luna is often self-centered, and like any child, has hopes and dreams of playing going on an adventure, easily annoyed if things don't go her way and having friends. Albeit her concept of "friendship" is initially, adding them to her undead legion, this is the reason why many people called her a cursed child.

When confronted with the truth, she initially breaks down as in her view, her parents were alive and she was with them. And to her, "Death" meant not the end of a person, but a type of bond that would finally get her friends, perhaps the time she was isolated in the house made the need for company stronger and Luna thought Necromancy was a mere game. As described by Nicola Adel her powers are bound to her emotions and, as she cannot control them, they often go berserk.

She is disheartened during her dream as not only does she learn her parents are not with her, but also that her magic is making them suffer, after this time, Luna begins considering herself a "bad girl" often crying and putting the blame on herself.

While still still going on by herself she finds the support of the rest of the group which makes her cope with the struggles they have to find. Deciding to confront reality, she understands her power make people suffer, this belief goes on until she travels to Izunia, where she meets her first friend, Nicola Adel and learns to fight for a precious person.

However, after meeting Aenea, Luna understands she is not alone anymore and the courage the rebel gave her turns into hope and Luna finds the power she needed to accept and fight for her friends and herself.

Traces of her noble, pampered upbringing are found in the way she talks, as Nicola describes her as a "Self-centered princess."

entries.name: The Keepers
entries.content:
The Keepers are god-like interdimensional entities that seek to destroy worlds through their Vessels.

It is the self-proclaimed duty of the Keepers to eliminate worlds. The Keepers and the apocalyptic destruction they bring are described by Nexus as "the natural order," and that all worlds are eventually fated to be destroyed. This is supported by Yuwan, who tells Eris that even if she hadn't summoned Nexus, another Keeper would have eventually appeared in the world native to the Kingdom of Aleister to destroy it regardless. Additionally, Keepers are described by the narration as "mere cog(s) of the mechanism," further lending credence to the idea that they are forces of nature and part of the greater workings of the universe.

Although Keepers possess great power equal to or above that of gods, they do not have their own physical forms, leading to the need for Vessels in which to act through. The Keeper themselves cannot be destroyed by harming their Vessels and can only, at worst, be rendered back to their true form. In their true forms, Keepers are small orbs of light, very weak and essentially powerless, unable defend themselves in any way or even speak. It's only in this state Keepers can be eradicated or alternatively, absorbed by another Keeper. When this occurs, some of the knowledge and power of the absorbed Keeper will be gained by the Keeper who consumed them.

Known Keepers

Nexus of Serenity
Nerva of Purgation
The Keeper of Stagnation

entries.name: 1 | Vessels
entries.content:
Vessels are those who allow a Keeper to possess their physical body as the Keeper carries out the destruction of a world. While someone is acting as a Vessel, they submit to the Keeper completely, surrendering any free will or consciousness of their own. The Keeper will then be in total control of their body and mind until the Vessel is released by the Keeper themselves, or the Keeper is forcibly ejected from the Vessel through external interference. Vessels, potential or former, are often identifiable by glowing markings on their skin which resemble circuitry, though it's possible to hide these marks.

Although this may not be the case for all Keepers, some such as Nerva appear to need willing Vessels, as Nerva was unable to make Belphomet into her Vessel without his direct agreement. It's also possible for Keepers to grant power to mortals without making them into Vessels. This was the case for Belphomet as well as Castelle, both of whom received power from Nerva, although anyone who obtains the power of a Keeper can still possibly become a Vessel later.

Once a Vessel has been released from their Keeper, the former Vessel gains immense power. They also become capable of traveling between worlds and can grant this ability to others as well. The extent of a former Vessel's power appears to depend on the Keeper or Vessel themselves. Yuwan and Maisha, former Vessels of Nerva, have formidable magical power as well as superhuman strength and abilities. Meanwhile, Fleauesse, a former Vessel of the Keeper of Stagnation, is classified as a goddess due to having become powerful enough to create an entire world from only a single stone, have total omniscience over the the world she created, and splitting aspects of herself into individual entities considered to be demigods. Currently, it's not known if former Vessels ejected from their Keepers by force obtain the same power(s) as Vessels who's Keepers released them of their own accord.

Known Vessels

Individuals whose status as former Vessels has been confirmed:

Yuwan Gilfrei
Maisha Laforge
Fleauesse
Losaria
Lydia

Possible Vessels

Individuals whose status as Vessels, former or future, has been suggested but is currently unclear or unconfirmed:

Kunitsu Amachi
Asagi Ryūgasaki

entries.name: 2 | Seraphs
entries.content:
Seraphs are servants of the Keepers who traverse worlds scouting potential Vessels. Seraphs are granted protection from their Keepers in order to aid them in carrying out their task of seeking possible Vessels and may also share the same circuit-like skin markings as (potential) Vessel(s).

Weiss, a Seraph of Purgation, describes himself as an "ambassador of a foreign goddess" and does not consider himself to be human. Weiss is the only currently known Seraph.

entries.name: The Shades
entries.content:
——Details——

The Shades are antagonists in Story Mode and the first season of the anime. They are spectral beings who act under the orders of Nexus and possibly other Keepers as well.

They are a manifestation of the darkness found inside everyone, born from Nexus power. Thus, they are capable of assuming the form of others, expressing their darkest feelings.

There are four variants, the Shadow Soldier, the Shadow Commander, the Shadow General, and the Shadow Berserker.

——Details [Anime]——

In the anime series, the Shades, here called "Empty Shadows," appear along with the Tree of Woe under command of Eiji Ryūgasaki.

They possess people, turning them against the chosen seven seeking to prevent them from obtaining the Mythical Cards. Although most possessed people lose all will of their own, some retain their consciousness, being dominated by their dark feelings. Possession of the Empty Shadows is reversed by defeating the possessed in a Shadowverse battle that uses psychic energy. Upon exhausting the psychic energy, the Empty Shadow leaves the victim's body.

The decks of those possessed by the Empty Shadows obtain cards of two different classes, as well as Shadow versions of some of their cards, and cards that create followers based on the different versions of the Shades.

The people who was possessed by Empty Shadows are:

Takuma Kibakura
Seiya Kibakura
Shiro Kiriyama
Vanessa Joubert
Vivian Joubert
Zuo Onizuka
Ko Habigami
Shiori Yonazuki
Mauro Abelard

The Empty Shadows reappear three years later during Shadowverse Flame, when Wolfram Zerga revives the Tree of Woe, spreading a dark mist across the world and plunging people into a dream.

entries.name: Alester
entries.content:
The Kingdom of Aleister is the country that Arisa, Isabelle, Rowen, Luna, Urias and Eris call home. While she originates from another country in the same world, Erika is also a citizen of Aleister. It is the main setting of the The Morning Star, The Morning Star: Conclusion and The Missing Star.

——History——

In ancient times, Vampires populated Aleister. However, one of them, Urias Foremonde, began to hunt other vampires, as to him, they misused their power and tormented the weak. With Urias being sealed away by the king of the land, vampires dissapear from the world.

Elves inhabits the forests, where they venerate the Tree of Life, protected by the Forest Guardians chosen by the trials given by the Tree of Life.

Alesteir is ruled by the royal family, currently including the Princess. Their military force include the Dragonbane Expedition, once lead by Rowen Dragespear.

Other kingdoms in this word includes Erika's homeland, where corrupt nobles used to employ assassins like Erika to eliminate whom they saw as threats.

entries.name: 1 | Arisa
entries.content:
——Details——

Arisa is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. She is striving to prove herself as a guardian of the forest and inseparable from her best friend Losaria, until one day a menacing creature appears in their path.

Arisa is the default leader of the Forestcraft class. In Shadowverse: Evolve, her leader card can be obtained in SD01: Regal Fairy Princess and BP01: Advent of Genesis.

——Personality——

Arisa is a very cheerful elf, being optimistic towards all people she meets. She always believes that there is good in others, even when they're an antagonist or villain. Having little knowledge of the world, Arisa is naïve, often being surprised at minor things, like the water canals in Isunia. She is a determined individual who's good heart often gets her in trouble, however, has the strength to move one. On occasion she is disheartened, such as when Nexus took Losaria away. Yet, her strong resolve makes her keep going.

Perhaps being the most sociable and kind of the group, Arisa is quick to make friends no matter where she goes, as seen with Setus and Maisha. She considers all the chosen ones as friends and, although each of them have a different reason for fighting and a different approach, Arisa believes in their bond and forgives them for any fault they may done to her.

Arisa is able to acknowledge her shortcomings, if they are visible to her, other times, her naïve mind is unable to discern them. This is seen in her dream, as unbeknownst to even her, she had a great deal of envy towards Losaria. While still considering her a friend, she had jealousy toward Losaria, as to her, Losaria was perfect and she was not.

Kind-hearted and warm, she often worries about Luna, who is just a child and got involved in a major battle, and towards any doubt or grief her companions may have.

——Anime Deck——

In the anime, the Arisa spirit uses a Forestcraft deck. The main objective of her strategy is to eliminate cards from the opponent's deck through Verdant Arrow and Forest Barrage, seeking to win by leaving the deck empty. Due to the influence of the shadow monster, some of her cards turned into "Dark" versions of themselves.

entries.name: 2 | Erika Sumeragi
entries.content:
——Details——

Erika Sumeragi is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. The protector to the Princess of Aleister, few are more skilled in the ways of swordsmanship, nor more reliable. When it comes down to it, she will let none stand between her and the life of the princess.

——Personality——

Erika is a very straight-forward person, doing whatever she is ordered to by the princess. Years of serving royalty softened her and made her apparently a soft spoken, shy maid.

In reality, she is a very strong-willed, determined individual who harbors a dark past. Although, she is still haunted by it, her loyalty to the princess is unwavering and is perhaps her very reason of existence. Losing her throws her into despair, as she could not confess her sins nor tell her her true nature, but vows to bring her back so the princess can accept her as she is.

She tends to only do what she believes is correct, and takes little to no advice from others into account. Her past made her become an aloof, cold person as she had to kill countless times.

Erika originally held little to no regard for her companions, but upon fighting alongside them and understanding they too have their own suffering (plus they all vowed to defeat the keepers) gradually opens up, especially to Arisa, with whom she forms a strong bond.

She is shown to have a soft spot for people who have been manipulated and, by extension, killed with no reason, as seen with the Countersolari Guild. Upon arriving at Isunia, she saw her own past in them. She had been used as an assassin and almost been killed in her country of origin, much like the task Countersolari took, so she sided with them.

Upon deciding she has found her enemy, she is willing to go to extreme lengths to terminate them, as seen with Urias. When battling him she decided to use a forbidden art to match him. Erika will stop at nothing to accomplish her goals, raising the concern of her comrades from time to time. She is not above attacking them either.

Being aloof and rarely speaking of herself, she operates independently and believes no one can understand her past or pain, although Yuwan, Arisa and the rest do offer her some comfort from time to time.

She is prone to anger when things do not go as planned and usually is very emotional and lets her anger get the best of her.

——Details [Anime]——

A spirit who takes Erika’s form appears before Kazuki Shindo in Episode 31, entrusting him with the Mythical Card.

The Erika Spirit appears in Episode 41. When Kazuki is transported from his dream world to the world of his Mythical Card, he ends up in the dungeons of a castle from which he escapes with Isabelle, being surprised by Erika who tries to recapture him, but is saved by his Victorious Blader. The two then face off in a Shadowverse battle.
Deck

In the anime, the Erika Spirit uses a Swordcraft deck composed mostly of cards with Ambush to be used in combination with the Killer Instincts amulet.

entries.name: 3 | Isabelle
entries.content:
——Details——

Isabelle is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. She is a brilliant alchemist who uses her knowledge for the benefit of humanity, but the tragic death of her fiancé Kyle Walker made her obsessed with the idea of resurrecting the dead

——Personality——

Isabelle is always searching for ways to better her magic abilities, hoping to one day be powerful enough to bring her dead fiancé back to life. She is the most powerful mage in her home world, very friendly, and willing to help those in need. However, she is somewhat of a socially awkward recluse; she rarely leaves her laboratory before the appearance of the Morning Star, she claims that Kyle was the only one who understood her and that Eleanor was her first real friend, and her card flair states that "the world was too big and cold without him". Though she seems reluctant to come out of her shell- for example, when encountering Yuwan in Aiolon, the two exchange pleasantries and discuss the situation before quickly parting ways- she is kindhearted and motherly, often worrying about Luna and struggling to cope with the violence of battle. She is emotional, easily becoming angry or upset in a manner similar to Yuwan, but also self-aware and introspective.

——Details [Anime]——

A spirit who takes Isabelle’s form appears before Kai Ijuin in Episode 28, entrusting him with the Mythical Card. She returns in Episode 41, helping Kazuki escape the castle's dungeon and later holding off Erika and the Guards with her magic.

The Isabelle spirit also appears in Episode 42. When Kai is transported from his dream world to the world of his Mythical Card, he wakes up in her lab. Isabelle's spirit saves him from the soldiers who want to burn down her lab and then takes him to her hideout. However, she forces him to become a subject of experimentation to find the forbidden magic. Kai breaks free thanks to his Chrono Witch card and faces Spirit Isabelle in a Shadowverse battle.

-Deck-

In the anime, Spirit Isabelle uses a Runecraft deck composed entirely of spells, her only followers being the ones she summons by effects. Her main resource are the Four Elements spells, which activate her most powerful cards, Quadra Magic and Elements of Creation.

entries.name: 4 | Rowen Dragespear
entries.content:
——Details——

Rowen Dragespear is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. An army commander with an intense sense of duty to the crown his comrades and his family, his life changed when a ferocious dragon attacked his squad. He is now trying to come to terms with the consequences.

——Personality——

Rowen is a very kind man, seeking to protect those he meets and help those in need. Though at first he tended to push people away as to not accidentally hurt them due to his curse, after he learned to control in, be tends to always put himself first so that other people will be safe.

——Details [Anime]——

A spirit who takes Rowen’s form appears before Hiro Ryūgasaki in Episode 27, entrusting him with the Mythical Card.

The spirit appears in Episode 37 and 38. When Hiro is transported from his dream world to the world of his Mythical Card, he meets Spirit Rowen in the middle of a battlefield where he and his army are fighting dragons. After Hiro saves Spirit Rowen by summoning Ignis Dragon, the two face off in a Shadowverse battle. Towards the end, Spirit Rowen reveals himself to be the black dragon that Hiro had to face. After winning, Hiro remembers that his world was in danger and manages to return to save it with Spirit Rowen promising to always be there for him when he needs it.

The spirit helps Hiro when he was about to lose against Eiji, giving his Mythical Card a new power.

In Shadowverse Flame, the spirit appears briefly during the battle between Light and Hiro, when Hiro plays the Avowed Strike card.

-Deck-

In the anime, Spirit Rowen plays a Dragoncraft deck focused on the Dragon Killer ability.

entries.name: 5 | Luna
entries.content:
——Details——

A spirit who takes Luna’s form appears before Alice Kurobane in Episode 28, entrusting her with the Mythical Card.

The Luna spirit appears again in Episode 40. When Alice is transported from her dream world to the world of her Mythical Card, she encounters her inside of her manor and the two face off in a Shadowverse battle. Although Spirit Luna is stoic at first, the two girls find their battle fun and she realizes how good "living friends" are.

—Deck—

In the anime, Luna's spirit uses a Shadowcraft deck. Her playstyle involves massively filling her graveyard to trigger huge Necromancy effects, at the cost of greatly reducing the cards in her deck. Her ace card is Absolute Spirit, which is immune to effect destruction, can destroy any follower that attacks it, and gains a massive attack boost while there is a high number of stored shadows.

entries.name: 6 | Urias Formonde
entries.content:
——Details——

Urias Formonde is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. An ancient vampire and the last of his kind, he was sealed away for centuries before an unknown force awakened him. Now he searches for an opponent who could rival him in the way that King Balthazar once did.

——Personality——

Urias is an extremely aggressive individual with one peculiarity, he only attacks those he deems worthy or strong. Having little regard for talk or diplomacy, he often resolves to violence. Battle being his prime interest. Unlike his demeanor, he is astute, and is quick to note when any individual is hiding strength.

As expressed to Eris Anthule, Urias views humans not as fodder, but as potential rivals who can, someday rival him, which is why, he doesn't consume them. He is even seeing interacting with them several times, albeit for his own interests, but Urias is capable of civility to a degree. He has little to no regard for the lives of others, even sometimes ditching them in the middle of adventures to pursue his own interests. Although, he often helps his comrades when they need him. His main interest being "finding people who can entertain him."

To him the strong and the weak have their privileges, which is why he only consumes the strong, as in his own words "attacking weakened or doubtful individuals is only a plebeian diversion." To him strength and thirst for battle on their own, mean nothing, only when both are combined is when a true mighty warrior is born.

Urias also dislikes assassination's techniques as to him, they are a cheap way to end a battle and stated to Leod that they would not work on his body.

Not caring to talk during a battle, Urias cares only about the power of the individual before him, but he is not above taunting or insulting his foes. Also, he does not like individuals who hold back and fails to understand the need to hide power. He also despises those who use power for no purpose, which is why he started killing fellow vampires as to him, "They forfeit the privilege to live in the night" as they let themselves be intoxicated with the smell of human blood. It is hinted that he lost his civility due to him being a vampire and people treating as such. During his younger years as a vampire, people ran away from him, even when the only thing he wanted was battle with the strong. This had an influence on him to resort to fighting, rather than talking.

Being very aged, Urias often gives pieces of advice to the group, as seen with Rowen Dragspear, Eris Anthule and Isabelle. Even so, he admits his vampiric powers come with only one small flaw; He has little, if any room for progress and considers himself complete, which is why he seeks battled with humans, as to him, they have limitless potential.

He, although very rarely, shows signs of chivalry and gentlemen manners as he calls some battles "A waltz" and "Trepidation is unbecoming in one of noble birth." Mono herself notes, that Urias only has the appearance of a gentleman but in reality, is a brute.

According to Mono, after battle he feels emptiness and he is clinging to something which he should let go and find some rest, namely the memory of his Friend, Balthazar. She compared him to Tetra which had to bear the burden of her sins.

——Details [Anime]——

A spirit that takes Urias's form appears before Luca Yonazuki in Episode 29, after Luca's true feelings unlock the Mythical Card.

The Urias spirit appears again in Episode 44. When Luca is transported from his dream world to the world of his Mythical Card, he encounters Spirit Urias inside of his castle and the two face off in a Shadowverse battle.

-Deck-

In the anime, Urias's spirit uses a Bloodcraft deck. His best ability is the Night King state which strengthens Vengeance effects as well as creating the three powerful spells that give effects to his own leader, allowing him to draw, damage the enemy leader and protect himself from the damage inflicted by his own cards.

entries.name: 7 | Eris Anthule
entries.content:
——Details——

Eris Anthule, known as Iris Anthule in Japan, is one of the main characters of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. A high priestess who works tirelessly to ease the suffering of humanity, she herself is plagued with doubts after waking up without any memory of her past.

——Personality——

Eris wants little more than the health and safety of others, always putting the issues of others above her own. She is very caring, and is somewhat understanding of how others act and why they do so.

Being a very peaceful and civil individual, she hates resorting to violence but is not above doing so, yet she fights only to injure foes as opposed to killing them- as seen with the Countersolari guild, leaving them unconscious before they could take their own lives.

Due to having seeing the suffering of her world, she believes in a "Salvation" in which the world finds happiness, no matter the method. This would become the reason that she summoned Nexus, albeit because Eris wanted what she thought was best for the world.

Under the control of Nexus, she displays cold emotion and little care for anything else than to bring "harmony" upon the land. However, after seeing the wills of the chosen ones and how the rejected Serenity, especially after her conversation with Urias Foremonde, she realizes the contradictions in her own logic and decides to save her cold world.

Originally she shows extreme determination towards her goals, undeterred by anything, but then becomes a brooding, sad individual, looking for her own path.

Eris is haunted by her sins as a vessel and finds herself lost at how to undo them. Some of her companions, namely Erika Sumeragi, harbor a grudge against her for silencing their world, but she understands their attitude towards her.

Being much more civil than the others in the group, Eris often asks the motives of other characters and is puzzled by their resolution, as pure or twisted as it may be. She is often shown wishing she could resolve herself to something, but ultimately accepts accountability for her sins and "gives life" as payment for what she's done.

After meeting Marlone and Major Meowskers, Eris finds the resolution in herself to keep going and try to make amends for her sins.

——Details [Anime]——

A spirit who takes Eris's form appears before Mauro Abelard in Episode 32, entrusting him with the Mythical Card.

The Eris spirit appears again in Episode 43. When Mauro is transported from his dream world to the world of her Mythical Card, he wakes up in Eris's church. After a conversation in which they conclude that they are inside a dream, Mauro faces the Eris spirit in a Shadowverse battle to return to his own world. During the battle, Mauro understands the importance of his companions and his willingness to keep moving on.

-Deck-

In the anime, Spirit Eris uses a Havencraft deck focused on Relic amulets which allow her in conjunction with her ace, Relic Goddess, to acquire an automatic victory.

entries.name: 8 | Yuwan Gilfrei
entries.content:
——Details——

Yuwan Gilfrei is one of the main protagonists of Shadowverse and chapters 1 through 9 of Story Mode. A vengeful warrior who has the power to traverse dimensions, he comes to fight alongside Arisa and the others to help them save their world from Nexus of Serenity.

——Personality——

Yuwan is a very mysterious man, who seems to show little to no emotion most of the time, and whenever he does he tries to suppress it. This comes as a result in him being manipulated by Nerva, the Keeper of Purgation.

He is very intelligent, witted and resourceful, having magic known only to keepers and foreign to the heroes of Aleister, with Urias inquiring where he got the power to "wield such strange sorcery". He will sometimes verbally activate it, usually with the command sequence "Activate, enhance, fire". He initially seems to dislike teleporting as it may pain him, but he uses it often; he is also capable of creating force-field-like barriers, and (perhaps in a nod to Nerva's manipulative ways) controlling people's minds, though he does not use this often as he considers it immoral. An extremely analytical individual, he assesses his enemies to see their potential, and even though he is extremely powerful, he is not above retreating to remake his strategy against powerful individuals, such as Urias Formonde. Yuwan thinks of his power as "sinful" and calls his path "sorrowful", but encountering the heroes of Aleister seems to have given him renewed hope. He also knows his revenge is not correct yet he appears to be ready for the consequences and shows similarities with Eris Anthule, albeit, he overcame his doubts and is ready to use his power for a greater good.

Yuwan harbors a very deep hatred against the keepers, namely Nerva of Purgation for destroying his home and ultimately betraying him; nothing angers him more than their ideals, goals, way of speaking, and arrogance, and he will stop at nothing against them. He once sought power, wanting to rule his land as King to set it on the right path, very much like Urias Formonde in his lust for battle, and he suffered things similar to Eris Anthule, which is why he compares himself to them in his time in Isunia.

Having seen various worlds destroyed has hardened him, but he is not above showing compassion and kindness to others; when not confronting a villainous character, he is usually quite polite, with his 4th anniversary leader encouraging a fair fight in his greeting voice line. He is sympathetic when discovering Erika Sumeragi's alliance with the Countersolari Guild, and becomes furious upon seeing how the Countersolari assassins took their own lives and how Belphomet Ardelyte oppressed the innocent. This also engraved him with an unwavering determination, seen various times in his struggles against the keepers. Even when all seems lost, Yuwan encourages the protagonists not to give up, and tells them determination and hope are the best weapons against the despair the keepers inflict.
